scope: Retrospective selected two-context logical-pass1 observations, Q=G_1(N1), after targets were known. P is the original full own-state forecast at the same cursor and N the actual clock-aligned native field. A=Q-N, B=P-Q, E=P-N; E=A+B. These signed vector accounts are not causal shares, isolated kernel errors, or prospective Q accuracy. The selected contexts differ in both supplied prompt factors. B is the difference between two whole-pass programs with different incoming latents; no G transport decomposition is inferred.
